# Third-party notices

The Waveshare board initialization, ES8311 driver, and audio service under
`firmware/waveshare/src` are adapted from
[`steveruizok/chat-stick`](https://github.com/steveruizok/chat-stick).

That project is MIT licensed. Its license is preserved in
`chat-stick-LICENSE`.

[`nicosuave/m5mic`](https://github.com/nicosuave/m5mic) was used as a design
reference for local WebSocket PCM streaming and mDNS discovery. No source from
that repository is currently copied into this project.
